### TRD-001 — Online self-scheduling

Customers expect to book, move and cancel appointments online at any hour.

- **Why it matters here:** The whole product is online self-scheduling; patients compare it with booking elsewhere.
- **Verification:** unverified; check before client presentation

### TRD-002 — Two-way SMS appointment reminders

Reminders customers can confirm or cancel by reply; widely used to cut no-shows.

- **Why it matters here:** Common answer to no-shows in dental practices; informs the reminders decision (Q-006).
- **Verification:** unverified; check before client presentation

### TRD-003 — Core Web Vitals as the performance yardstick

LCP, INP and CLS measured on real users are the common way to set web performance targets.

- **Why it matters here:** Gives the client a standard way to state the NFR-001 target.
- **Verification:** unverified; check before client presentation

### TRD-004 — Accessibility laws for digital services

Laws increasingly require WCAG-level accessibility for consumer-facing digital services.

- **Why it matters here:** A public healthcare booking page is likely covered; check which law applies (Q-005, Q-009).
- **Verification:** unverified; check before client presentation

### TRD-005 — Passkeys replacing passwords

Sign-in with device-bound WebAuthn credentials, supported by the major platforms.

- **Why it matters here:** An option for Q-004 if patient accounts are chosen; overkill for twice-yearly visits without accounts.
- **Verification:** unverified; check before client presentation

### TRD-006 — SMS one-time codes as the only second factor

SMS codes are vulnerable to SIM swap and phishing; services are moving to app, passkey or push factors.

- **Why it matters here:** If identity is checked by code, avoid SMS as the only factor for access to health data.
- **Verification:** unverified; check before client presentation

### TRD-007 — Invisible bot protection instead of visual CAPTCHAs

Risk-based, mostly invisible checks replace puzzles that block real users and fail accessibility.

- **Why it matters here:** Protects a login-free public page without hurting accessibility.
- **Verification:** unverified; check before client presentation

### TRD-008 — Voice AI agents for phone calls

AI agents answer phone calls and complete simple tasks such as booking.

- **Why it matters here:** Targets the client's real problem (busy phone line); maturity and patient acceptance need checking.
- **Verification:** unverified; check before client presentation

### TRD-009 — Business messaging on WhatsApp and similar apps

Customers are reached on chat apps they already use, with templates and opt-in.

- **Why it matters here:** Depends on the country (Q-005) and what patients there use.
- **Verification:** unverified; check before client presentation
